name: The Sandown Clown
source:
They thought it was a clown. Or maybe a robot. Or maybe something else entirely. Uncover the unsettling encounter that became one of the UK's strangest unsolved cases – The Sandown Clown.

[From [url=https://torgomind.itch.io/the-sandown-clown]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
他们认为这是一个小丑。或者也许是一个机器人。或者也许完全是别的东西。揭开令人不安的遭遇，它成为英国最奇怪的未破案件之一——桑当小丑。

[来自[url=https://torgomind.itch.io/the-sandown-clown]Itch.io[/url]]
